verses.original: נַחֲמ֥וּ נַחֲמ֖וּ עַמִּ֑י יֹאמַ֖ר אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·mū na·ḥă·mū ‘am·mî yō·mar ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Comfort comfort My people says your God

verses.original: דַּבְּר֞וּ עַל־ לֵ֤ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וְקִרְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֤י צְבָאָ֔הּ מָֽלְאָה֙ עֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּ֤י נִרְצָ֖ה כִּ֥י לָקְחָה֙ מִיַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּפְלַ֖יִם בְּכָל־ חַטֹּאתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: dab·bə·rū ‘al- lêḇ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·qir·’ū ’ê·le·hā kî ṣə·ḇā·’āh mā·lə·’āh ‘ă·wō·nāh kî nir·ṣāh kî lā·qə·ḥāh mî·yaḏ Yah·weh kip̄·la·yim bə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Speak tenderly to . . . Jerusalem and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed her iniquity . . . has been pardoned For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins

verses.original: ק֣וֹל קוֹרֵ֔א פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֕ר יַשְּׁרוּ֙ מְסִלָּ֖ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ בָּעֲרָבָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: qō·wl qō·w·rê pan·nū de·reḵ Yah·weh bam·miḏ·bār yaš·šə·rū mə·sil·lāh lê·lō·hê·nū bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: A voice of one calling Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness make a straight highway for our God in the desert

verses.original: כָּל־ גֶּיא֙ יִנָּשֵׂ֔א וְכָל־ הַ֥ר וְגִבְעָ֖ה יִשְׁפָּ֑לוּ הֶֽעָקֹב֙ וְהָיָ֤ה לְמִישׁ֔וֹר וְהָרְכָסִ֖ים לְבִקְעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ge yin·nā·śê wə·ḵāl har wə·ḡiḇ·‘āh yiš·pā·lū he·‘ā·qōḇ wə·hā·yāh lə·mî·šō·wr wə·hā·rə·ḵā·sîm lə·ḇiq·‘āh
verses.literal: Every valley shall be lifted up and every mountain and hill made low the uneven [ground] will become smooth and the rugged land a plain

verses.original: כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה וְנִגְלָ֖ה כָל־ בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְרָא֤וּ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh wə·niḡ·lāh ḵāl bā·śār yaḥ·dāw wə·rā·’ū kî pî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed and all humanity together will see it For the mouth of the LORD has spoken

verses.original: ק֚וֹל אֹמֵ֣ר קְרָ֔א וְאָמַ֖ר מָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א כָּל־ הַבָּשָׂ֣ר חָצִ֔יר וְכָל־ חַסְדּ֖וֹ כְּצִ֥יץ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ’ō·mêr qə·rā wə·’ā·mar māh ’eq·rā kāl- hab·bā·śār ḥā·ṣîr wə·ḵāl ḥas·dōw kə·ṣîṣ haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: A voice says Cry out And I asked What should I cry out All flesh is like grass and all its glory like the flowers of the field

verses.original: חָצִיר֙ יָבֵ֤שׁ צִ֔יץ נָ֣בֵֽל כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה נָ֣שְׁבָה בּ֑וֹ אָכֵ֥ן הָעָֽם׃ חָצִ֖יר
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṣîr yā·ḇêš ṣîṣ nā·ḇêl kî rū·aḥ Yah·weh nā·šə·ḇāh bōw ’ā·ḵên hā·‘ām ḥā·ṣîr
verses.literal: The grass withers [and] the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them indeed the people are grass

verses.original: חָצִ֖יר יָבֵ֥שׁ צִ֑יץ נָ֣בֵֽל וּדְבַר־ אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יָק֥וּם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṣîr yā·ḇêš ṣîṣ nā·ḇêl ū·ḏə·ḇar- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū yā·qūm lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The grass withers [and] the flowers fall but the word of our God stands forever

verses.original: עֲלִי־ לָךְ֙ עַ֣ל גָּבֹ֤הַ הַר־ צִיּ֔וֹן מְבַשֶּׂ֣רֶת הָרִ֤ימִי קוֹלֵ֔ךְ בַכֹּ֙חַ֙ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מְבַשֶּׂ֖רֶת הָרִ֙ימִי֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֔אִי אִמְרִי֙ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lî- lāḵ ‘al gā·ḇō·ha har- ṣî·yō·wn mə·ḇaś·śe·reṯ hā·rî·mî qō·w·lêḵ ḇak·kō·aḥ yə·rū·šā·lim mə·ḇaś·śe·reṯ hā·rî·mî ’al- tî·rā·’î ’im·rî lə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh hin·nêh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Go up on a high mountain O Zion herald of good news Raise your voice loudly . . . O Jerusalem herald of good news Lift [it] up do not be afraid Say to the cities of Judah Here is your God

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ יָב֔וֹא בְּחָזָ֣ק וּזְרֹע֖וֹ מֹ֣שְׁלָה ל֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh yā·ḇō·w bə·ḥā·zāq ū·zə·rō·‘ōw mō·šə·lāh lōw hin·nêh śə·ḵā·rōw ’it·tōw ū·p̄ə·‘ul·lā·ṯōw lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Behold the Lord GOD comes with might and His arm establishes His rule . . . His reward is with Him and His recompense accompanies Him

verses.original: כְּרֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים בִּזְרֹעוֹ֙ יִשָּׂ֑א וּבְחֵיק֖וֹ יְנַהֵֽל׃ס עָל֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: kə·rō·‘eh ‘eḏ·rōw yir·‘eh yə·qab·bêṣ ṭə·lā·’îm biz·rō·‘ōw yiś·śā ū·ḇə·ḥê·qōw yə·na·hêl ‘ā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: He tends His flock like a shepherd He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart He gently leads the nursing [ewes]

verses.original: מִֽי־ מָדַ֨ד מַ֗יִם בְּשָׁעֳל֜וֹ תִּכֵּ֔ן וְשָׁמַ֙יִם֙ בַּזֶּ֣רֶת וְכָ֥ל עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּשָּׁלִ֖שׁ וְשָׁקַ֤ל הָרִ֔ים בַּפֶּ֙לֶס֙ וּגְבָע֖וֹת בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- mā·ḏaḏ ma·yim bə·šā·‘o·lōw tik·kên wə·šā·ma·yim baz·ze·reṯ wə·ḵāl ‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ baš·šā·liš wə·šā·qal hā·rîm bap·pe·les ū·ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ bə·mō·zə·nā·yim
verses.literal: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand or marked off the heavens with the span of his hand? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket or weighed the mountains on a scale and the hills with a balance

verses.original: מִֽי־ תִכֵּ֥ן אֶת־ ר֖וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֥ישׁ יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃ עֲצָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: mî- ṯik·kên ’eṯ- rū·aḥ Yah·weh wə·’îš yō·w·ḏî·‘en·nū ‘ă·ṣā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Who has directed - the Spirit of the LORD . . . or informed Him [as] His counselor

verses.original: מִ֤י נוֹעָץ֙ אֶת־ וַיְבִינֵ֔הוּ וַֽיְלַמְּדֵ֖הוּ בְּאֹ֣רַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וַיְלַמְּדֵ֣הוּ דַ֔עַת יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃ וְדֶ֥רֶךְ תְּבוּנ֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: mî nō·w·‘āṣ ’eṯ- way·ḇî·nê·hū way·lam·mə·ḏê·hū bə·’ō·raḥ miš·pāṭ way·lam·mə·ḏê·hū ḏa·‘aṯ yō·w·ḏî·‘en·nū wə·ḏe·reḵ tə·ḇū·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Whom did He consult . . . to enlighten Him and who taught Him the paths of justice Who imparted knowledge to Him and showed Him the way of understanding

verses.original: הֵ֤ן גּוֹיִם֙ כְּמַ֣ר מִדְּלִ֔י נֶחְשָׁ֑בוּ הֵ֥ן וּכְשַׁ֥חַק מֹאזְנַ֖יִם יִטּֽוֹל׃ אִיִּ֖ים כַּדַּ֥ק
verses.transliteration: hên gō·w·yim kə·mar mid·də·lî neḥ·šā·ḇū hên ū·ḵə·ša·ḥaq mō·zə·na·yim yiṭ·ṭō·wl ’î·yîm kad·daq
verses.literal: Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket they are considered . . . a speck of dust on the scales He lifts up the islands like fine dust

verses.original: וּלְבָנ֕וֹן אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י בָּעֵ֑ר וְחַיָּת֔וֹ אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י עוֹלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ’ên dê bā·‘êr wə·ḥay·yā·ṯōw ’ên dê ‘ō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Lebanon [is] not sufficient for fuel nor its animals . . . enough for a burnt offering

verses.original: כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם כְּאַ֣יִן נֶגְדּ֑וֹ נֶחְשְׁבוּ־ לֽוֹ׃ מֵאֶ֥פֶס וָתֹ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: kāl- hag·gō·w·yim kə·’a·yin neḡ·dōw neḥ·šə·ḇū- lōw mê·’e·p̄es wā·ṯō·hū
verses.literal: All the nations are as nothing before Him He regards them as nothingness and emptiness

verses.original: מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־ וּמַה־ דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî tə·ḏam·mə·yūn ’êl wə·’el- ū·mah- də·mūṯ ta·‘ar·ḵū lōw
verses.literal: To whom will you liken God - To what image will you compare Him

verses.original: הַפֶּ֙סֶל֙ חָרָ֔שׁ נָסַ֣ךְ וְצֹרֵ֖ף יְרַקְּעֶ֑נּוּ בַּזָּהָ֣ב צוֹרֵֽף׃ כֶּ֖סֶף וּרְתֻק֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: hap·pe·sel ḥā·rāš nā·saḵ wə·ṣō·rêp̄ yə·raq·qə·‘en·nū baz·zā·hāḇ ṣō·w·rêp̄ ke·sep̄ ū·rə·ṯu·qō·wṯ
verses.literal: To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold and fits with silver chains

verses.original: הַֽמְסֻכָּ֣ן תְּרוּמָ֔ה יִבְחָ֑ר עֵ֥ץ לֹֽא־ יִרְקַ֖ב יְבַקֶּשׁ־ ל֔וֹ חָכָם֙ חָרָ֤שׁ לְהָכִ֥ין פֶּ֖סֶל לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: ham·suk·kān tə·rū·māh yiḇ·ḥār ‘êṣ lō- yir·qaḇ yə·ḇaq·qeš- lōw ḥā·ḵām ḥā·rāš lə·hā·ḵîn pe·sel lō yim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: One lacking such an offering chooses wood that will not rot He seeks a skilled craftsman to set up an idol that will not topple

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא תֵֽדְעוּ֙ הֲל֣וֹא תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הֲל֛וֹא הֻגַּ֥ד מֵרֹ֖אשׁ לָכֶ֑ם הֲלוֹא֙ הֲבִ֣ינֹתֶ֔ם מוֹסְד֖וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ṯê·ḏə·‘ū hă·lō·w ṯiš·mā·‘ū hă·lō·w hug·gaḏ mê·rōš lā·ḵem hă·lō·w hă·ḇî·nō·ṯem mō·ws·ḏō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Do you not know Have you not heard Has it not been declared to you from the beginning Have you not understood since the foundation of the earth

verses.original: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַל־ ח֣וּג הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כַּחֲגָבִ֑ים הַנּוֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֔יִם כַדֹּק֙ וַיִּמְתָּחֵ֥ם כָּאֹ֖הֶל לָשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·šêḇ ‘al- ḥūḡ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā ka·ḥă·ḡā·ḇîm han·nō·w·ṭeh šā·ma·yim ḵad·dōq way·yim·tā·ḥêm kā·’ō·hel lā·šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth its dwellers are like grasshoppers He stretches out the heavens like a curtain and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in

verses.original: הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן רוֹזְנִ֖ים לְאָ֑יִן עָשָֽׂה׃ שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אֶ֖רֶץ כַּתֹּ֥הוּ
verses.transliteration: han·nō·w·ṯên rō·wz·nîm lə·’ā·yin ‘ā·śāh šō·p̄ə·ṭê ’e·reṣ kat·tō·hū
verses.literal: He brings the princes to nothing and makes the rulers of the earth meaningless

verses.original: אַ֣ף בַּל־ נִטָּ֗עוּ אַ֚ף בַּל־ זֹרָ֔עוּ אַ֛ף בַּל־ גִּזְעָ֑ם שֹׁרֵ֥שׁ בָּאָ֖רֶץ וְגַם־ נָשַׁ֤ף בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּבָ֔שׁוּ וּסְעָרָ֖ה תִּשָּׂאֵֽם׃ס כַּקַּ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ bal- niṭ·ṭā·‘ū ’ap̄ bal- zō·rā·‘ū ’ap̄ bal- giz·‘ām šō·rêš bā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḡam- nā·šap̄ bā·hem way·yi·ḇā·šū ū·sə·‘ā·rāh tiś·śā·’êm kaq·qaš
verses.literal: No sooner . . . are they planted no sooner . . . are they sown no sooner . . . have their stems taken root in the ground than He blows on them and they wither and a whirlwind sweeps them away like stubble

verses.original: וְאֶל־ מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- mî ṯə·ḏam·mə·yū·nî wə·’eš·weh yō·mar qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: To whom will you liken Me or who is My equal asks the Holy One

verses.original: שְׂאוּ־ עֵינֵיכֶ֤ם מָר֨וֹם וּרְאוּ֙ מִי־ בָרָ֣א אֵ֔לֶּה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא צְבָאָ֑ם בְמִסְפָּ֖ר יִקְרָ֔א לְכֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם מֵרֹ֤ב אוֹנִים֙ וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֔חַ לֹ֥א אִ֖ישׁ נֶעְדָּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: śə·’ū- ‘ê·nê·ḵem mā·rō·wm ū·rə·’ū mî- ḇā·rā ’êl·leh ham·mō·w·ṣî ṣə·ḇā·’ām ḇə·mis·pār yiq·rā lə·ḵul·lām bə·šêm mê·rōḇ ’ō·w·nîm wə·’am·mîṣ kō·aḥ lō ’îš ne‘·dār
verses.literal: Lift up your eyes on high - Who created all these He leads forth the starry host by number He calls each one by name Because of His great power and mighty strength not one of them is missing

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תֹאמַר֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּתְדַבֵּ֖ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דַרְכִּי֙ נִסְתְּרָ֤ה מֵֽיְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י יַעֲבֽוֹר׃ וּמֵאֱלֹהַ֖י
verses.transliteration: lām·māh ṯō·mar ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ṯə·ḏab·bêr yiś·rā·’êl ḏar·kî nis·tə·rāh Yah·weh miš·pā·ṭî ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr ū·mê·’ĕ·lō·hay
verses.literal: Why do you say O Jacob and why do you assert O Israel My way is hidden from the LORD and my claim is ignored by my God

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא יָדַ֜עְתָּ אִם־ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ יְהוָה֙ עוֹלָ֤ם׀ אֱלֹהֵ֨י בּוֹרֵא֙ קְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִיעַ֖ף וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֑ע לִתְבוּנָתֽוֹ׃ אֵ֥ין חֵ֖קֶר
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w yā·ḏa‘·tā ’im- lō šā·ma‘·tā Yah·weh ‘ō·w·lām ’ĕ·lō·hê bō·w·rê qə·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lō yî·‘ap̄ wə·lō yî·ḡā‘ liṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯōw ’ên ḥê·qer
verses.literal: Do you not know . . . Have you not heard The LORD is the everlasting God the Creator of the ends of the earth He will not grow tired . . . or weary His understanding is beyond searching out

verses.original: נֹתֵ֥ן כֹּ֑חַ לַיָּעֵ֖ף יַרְבֶּֽה׃ עָצְמָ֥ה וּלְאֵ֥ין אוֹנִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: nō·ṯên kō·aḥ lay·yā·‘êp̄ yar·beh ‘ā·ṣə·māh ū·lə·’ên ’ō·w·nîm
verses.literal: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak . . .

verses.original: נְעָרִ֖ים וְיִֽעֲפ֥וּ וְיִגָ֑עוּ וּבַחוּרִ֖ים כָּשׁ֥וֹל יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·‘ā·rîm wə·yi·‘ă·p̄ū wə·yi·ḡā·‘ū ū·ḇa·ḥū·rîm kā·šō·wl yik·kā·šê·lū
verses.literal: Even youths grow tired and weary and young men stumble and fall

verses.original: וְקוֹיֵ֤ יְהוָה֙ יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֔חַ יַעֲל֥וּ אֵ֖בֶר כַּנְּשָׁרִ֑ים יָר֙וּצוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֔עוּ יֵלְכ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א יִיעָֽפוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·qō·w·yê Yah·weh ya·ḥă·lî·p̄ū ḵō·aḥ ya·‘ă·lū ’ê·ḇer kan·nə·šā·rîm yā·rū·ṣū wə·lō yî·ḡā·‘ū yê·lə·ḵū wə·lō yî·‘ā·p̄ū
verses.literal: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength they will mount up with wings like eagles they will run and not grow weary they will walk and not faint
